source: Chen, D. (2015). Online Retail. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5BW33
transformations: First 1000 valid product stock codes in source order; all positive sales lines for those codes retained
Cancellations, non-positive prices/quantities, missing names and non-numeric-leading codes excluded
Last observed retained description and price per code; catalogue prices rounded to two decimals
Categories inferred using keyword rules, not supplied by retailer
Ratings generated deterministically for teaching, not customer feedback
Graph uses eight active users among first 100 observed users, with anonymized IDs and purchase-line-count weights
Sales use historical transaction unit prices, not current catalog prices; totals exclude returns and are not net revenue
